Ch'r'ai Tska'an is a githyanki warlock.[1] She is near the exit of Act Two, the Road to Baldur's Gate.
“
W'wargaz failed to kill you. I won't make the same mistake!
„
— Tska'an

Involvement

Act Two

Ch'r'ai Tska'an and her group of Githyanki lie in wait to ambush the party when they approach the  Road to Baldur's Gate Waypoint at X: -263 Y: -37. Carrying the  Qua'nith Psionic Detector, whether gifted by  Voss or looted off his corpse, allows the party to spot their ambush and possibly surprise the raiding party instead.

Act Three

If the party are not marked for death by  Vlaakith, Tska’an and her entourage do not appear at the ambush spot. If this is the case, Tska'an moves to the Knights of the Shield Hideout in Act Three where she can be fought as part of the quest ⁠Visit the Emperor's Old Hideout.

Combat

In combat, Tska'an functions as a gish and an Undead Patron warlock.

Honour Mode

 Legendary Action: Soul Sacrifice

Once per round when a humanoid dies, the Ch'r'ai can spend a legendary action to  Sacrifice its soul to ⁠Vlaakith in return for great power. Once 3 souls have been sacrificed, the Ch'r'ai takes on  Vlaakith's Undying Aspect.

Encounter details

  • Tska'an and her squad block the party from proceeding to Baldur's Gate and Act Three. Tska'an begins the battle standing on an archway flanked by two Veteran Githyanki Raiders who often use  Trip Attack and fire  Arrows of Many Targets. Below her are two Veteran Githyanki Warriors armed with Githyanki Parry.
  • All members of the gith ambush carry weapons imbued with  Light, to protect them from the weaker areas of the Shadow Curse on the border of Reithwin.

Tactics

  • An effective way to begin the fight is using spells like  Enhance Leap,  Misty Step, or  Dimension Door to get the entire party onto the top of the archway and begin focusing attacks on the raiders. Alternatively, the party can sneak their way onto the archway via a path to the north before the githyanki appear and  surprise them. The warriors below are then forced to waste a turn or two taking the long way around or using Enhance Leap to follow with a jump.
  • Tska'an and her entourage can be affected by the Shadow curse. Retreating deeper into the town of Reithwin or trapping them in a source of darkness (e.g., from  Hunger of Hadar or  Darkness) suppresses the  Light spell on their weapons, causing them to take damage from the curse every turn. However, if they die to the curse they are revived with half health as  Shadow-Cursed Undead, hostile to everyone – including the still-living githyanki.

Notes and references

  1. ↑ Tska’an displays the abilities of an Undead Patron warlock from D&D 5e, though the subclass is not available to player characters. Her patron appears to be  Vlaakith, though she is not available as a patron to (githyanki) player character warlocks. See the Githyanki page for more details.
